The measured 191-file/43,404,937-byte image fits the 512-file/64-MiB caps. The r4 executable is sha256sum; its evidence does not establish Java startup or Alloy behavior.
assessment.ownership_and_capacity: Reservation precedes spawn; attempted spawn cannot take a no-spawn release. The shared enabled-mode ledger counts warm and fresh JVM trees through STARTING, READY, BUSY, RETIRING and UNKNOWN. The public barrier closes the child-registration interval before application execution. Captured group descriptors and generation identity, exact direct-child reap plus positive group-empty, and sticky uncertainty give a coherent release rule. Restart must hold the private lock and reconcile every journal entry; unresolved pre-key state disables admission. These are implementable contract obligations, not properties established by current fresh WorkerCapacity or Process.destroyForcibly.
assessment.cancellation_and_publication: The staged-result lease retains ownership through public-envelope construction. Its publication method must perform the new full installed-image/Alloy scan and recheck deadline/cancellation at the declared publication linearization point. Cancellation before publication suppresses success, including after response staging or reap. The contract avoids accepting a cached earlier fence and does not promise retraction after publication. Timeout suppresses success without releasing uncertain capacity or claiming an unconditional response-time bound.

assessment.performance_hypothesis: A READY hit can move JVM startup and fixed public class initialization off the admitted private path, but each request still consumes a new JVM and pays context, validation, identity scans, cleanup, envelope construction and the new final fence. Refill still consumes whole-stack CPU and memory. Bootstrap-only Class.forName is not demonstrated elimination of parser/JIT cost. One standby may hide startup under some arrivals while exposing refill or cold misses at sustained load; no numerical gain or throughput promise is established. The unchanged strict paired HTTP gate, normal refill scheduling, empty-pool cold cycles, 2/s open-loop scheduled-arrival latency and soak/sequence gates are appropriate falsifiers.
